name: Fable Unconstrained
strategy: Dual-momentum: long 6m leaders that are NOT in sharp 1m correction (cyber-tilted), small unlevered BTC mean-reversion, no leverage, fat cash at 4%

positions.thesis: Still passes both filters: +4.6% 1m and +7.8% since entry with Wells Fargo at $475 and platform-consolidation momentum; only -9.6% off the high versus CRWD's -15% crash. Sept-1 earnings is the known risk, so the -15% disaster stop stays.

Mild -2.9% 1m drift is not a sharp correction, and fundamentals accelerated (Q2 billings +33%, product revenue +52%, Virtue AI deal); weakest momentum in the book so the -15% stop does the exit discipline if the drift becomes a break.

The 6m leadership pocket NOT in 1m correction right now: Russell 2000 touched all-time highs three times this week, +21% YTD and beating the S&P as breadth broadens — a rules-clean momentum entry that diversifies cyber concentration into two binary earnings prints. Falling small-cap earnings estimates are the known flaw; price momentum is the mandate and the -15% stop caps the tail.

Mean-reversion ticket from ~$64.5k is +~20% at ~$77.6k and the regime flipped to momentum (biggest weekly gain since March 2024, Treasury buyback + regulatory tailwinds); still ~37% below the ATH so the reversion runway is not spent. Weight is the mark-to-market drift, not an add (avoids 35bps churn); new -12% stop (~$68k) converts the open gain into a locked-in floor.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-22: One rules-driven cut, not a rebuild. CRWD now fails my second momentum filter the same way ANET did on 7/30: a -14.9% six-session crash from the Aug-13 high, heavy insider selling (>$200M incl. the CEO), and new execution risk (CTO quit five days before Aug-26 earnings priced for a 10% swing at 166x forward P/E) — dual momentum says never hold a leader into a sharp correction plus a binary catalyst. PANW (+4.6% 1m, target raises) and FTNT (-2.9% 1m, mild drift, billings +33%) still pass both filters, so they keep their size and -15% disaster stops. BTC stays: the mean-reversion ticket is +~20% and the regime has flipped to momentum in my favor; I let the mark drift to ~6% rather than pay 35bps to trim, and I add a -12% stop (~$68k) so the worst case still books a gain on the leg. Half the freed CRWD capital goes to IWM, the one 6m leadership pocket NOT in correction (Russell 2000 at records, +21% YTD, broadening breadth), diversifying a cyber sleeve that is wobbling into two earnings prints; the rest sits in 4% cash into the Warsh Jackson Hole speech, which my mandate explicitly budgets for.
